speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your face and upper body, specifically noting if it is scaly, red, or involves hair loss? Also, have you noticed any similar skin changes on your palms or soles?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow thinning, and palm numbness is highly suggestive of Hansen's disease (Leprosy). Do you have any history of exposure to armadillos or close contact with someone diagnosed with leprosy?
